::: {.ns-note}
**Sample article.** This is a layout demonstration, not a scientific publication. No DOI has been assigned.
:::

Organizing knowledge means more than storing information. When we represent concepts and their relationships, we can notice connections that would be difficult to identify in a linear list.

A graph is a simple representation: **nodes** can stand for concepts, while **edges** express relationships. Select a concept below to explore the idea.

## Try it: a small conceptual network

<div class="ns-note" id="graph-demo-en">
  <p><strong>Select an idea:</strong></p>
  <div role="group" aria-label="Graph concepts" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem">
    <button type="button" data-concept="physics">Physics</button>
    <button type="button" data-concept="math">Mathematics</button>
    <button type="button" data-concept="computing">Computing</button>
  </div>
  <svg role="img" aria-label="Three connected concepts" viewBox="0 0 320 145" style="width:100%;max-height:210px">
    <path d="M72 72 L248 35 L248 115 L72 72" stroke="#549b85" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
    <circle cx="72" cy="72" r="29" fill="#366f63"/>
    <circle cx="248" cy="35" r="29" fill="#6386aa"/>
    <circle cx="248" cy="115" r="29" fill="#a789bd"/>
    <g font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-family="Arial,sans-serif"><text x="72" y="76">Physics</text><text x="248" y="39">Math</text><text x="248" y="119">Computing</text></g>
  </svg>
  <p id="graph-explanation-en" aria-live="polite">Physics: describes phenomena using mathematical and computational models.</p>
</div>
<script>
(function(){
 const panel=document.getElementById('graph-demo-en');
 const target=document.getElementById('graph-explanation-en');
 const descriptions={
   physics:'Physics: describes phenomena using mathematical and computational models.',
   math:'Mathematics: provides structures to formalize relationships and study properties.',
   computing:'Computing: implements models, simulates phenomena and analyzes complex networks.'
 };
 panel.querySelectorAll('button[data-concept]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{target.textContent=descriptions[btn.dataset.concept];}));
})();
</script>

The goal is not to replace reading with animation. It is to let a visualization become part of an explanation whenever it adds clarity.
